title: machine
description: One row of the `machine` table. Keys and order follow schemas/schema.sql; NULL columns are omitted, never written as null (data-model.md §4.3).

mame_year.description: Verbatim MAME string; may be `19??`. The parsed value is v_machine.year.

mame_manufacturer.description: Verbatim MAME string; resolved through manufacturer_alias.

clone_count.description: How many clone sets MAME lists under this parent. A base fact from MAME, not an aggregate over `machine`: extraction is parents-only, so no clone row exists here.
